values.note: Operator's rates page, read 2026-10-21, tax included: partial hookup $34, full hookup $45, the one boondocking site $20. Weekly: seventh night free; monthly $560 plus tax (six months max). Rates cover 2 adults and 2 children, +$2 a night per extra guest. No deposit and no cancellation charge.

fees.source: https://www.whitespringsrvpark.com/terms-conditions-copy ('Full Hookup $45.00 includes tax', 'Partial Hookup $34.00 includes tax', 'Boondocking $20.00 includes tax'), read 2026-10-21

hookups.source: https://www.whitespringsrvpark.com/amenities-maple ('All Hookups accommodating either 30 or 50 amps', 'Full Hookups are electric, water, and sewage'), read 2026-10-21

sites.source: https://www.whitespringsrvpark.com/ ('All of our sites are pull-thru') + https://www.whitespringsrvpark.com/amenities-maple ('RV sites are flat, pull-thru and mostly shaded'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 'We do not have facilities. Laundry and restroom/showers are not available on property.' Fresh-water fill station for boondock and partial-hookup sites; dump station on the way out. Free firewood for the fire pits.

facilities.source: https://www.whitespringsrvpark.com/amenities-maple ('Please Note: We do not have facilities. Laundry and restroom/showers are not available on property', 'A Fresh water fill station is available', 'A Dump Station is available before exiting the property'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: An availability-inquiry form on the operator's site or a phone call; 'Your reservation is NOT booked until' the park confirms by email. A specific site cannot be promised. Check-in after 2 p.m., check-out by 11 a.m.

booking.source: https://www.whitespringsrvpark.com/book-your-stay-index-maple ('You are requesting information on availability by filling out this form. Your reservation is NOT booked until you have further communication confirming the details') + https://www.whitespringsrvpark.com/terms-conditions-copy (check-in/out), read 2026-10-21

note: Transient/nightly RV park off I-75 near White Springs in the Suwannee River Valley; small, wooded and family-owned. Office open 7 days a week. --Claude
summary: Operator site confirms $34-$45 (tax included), all pull-through, water+sewer; added 30/50 A, no restrooms/showers/laundry, water fill + dump station, booking by inquiry form/phone. Not stated: site count, max rig length, season.
